behaviors.scope: Owned admission permits only selected moving record current-cell/chain-location divergence in disabled mode; validates owned chain structure and other records, requires slot membership, ignores unused cleanup input, and refuses enabled updates without reconciliation; supported partial results commit atomically while unsupported inputs retain exception rollback; original malformed graph/caller handling is not implied

behaviors.title: Remaining effect movement and lifecycle contracts
behaviors.scope: Selected effect movement, terrain occupancy, footprint lookup/initialization and bounded creature candidate snapshot/status filtering/raw coordinate production/first-hit collision integration are recovered separately. Kind34 creator selection for supported types is recovered separately; other types/nonzero metadata and termination, type35 terrain mutation, remaining effect creation/type-dispatch parents and installed trajectory inputs, creature descriptors and construction/lifecycle, installed catalogs/cells/columns and live scheduling remain unimplemented/unverified; combined branch coverage remains bounded by authored fixtures. The whole trajectory initializer is recovered separately from authored inputs. Whole 0048a950 motion record setup is recovered separately from valid authored inputs. Whole animation selection is recovered separately from owned metadata and valid required creature descriptors. Owned effect ANI binding and forward controller state are recovered separately from static caller resolution and authored inputs; full caller integration remains pending. Installed effect animation catalog loading and owned binding are separately validated by native offline evidence; original collection loader execution, caller/dispatcher asset admission, direction variants, Data1/property consumers, drawing and lifecycle/live integration remain pending.
